title: Rev. Proc. 2024-40 (inflation adjustments for taxable years beginning in 2025 and returns required to be filed in 2026)

passages.question: Which official source sets $255 for a return required to be filed in 2026?
passages.excerpt: Failure to File Partnership Return. In the case of any return required to be filed in 2026, the dollar amount used to determine the amount of the penalty under § 6698(b)(1) is $255.

passages.question: What is the section 448(c) gross receipts amount for a year beginning in 2025, and does HANGS meet it?
passages.excerpt: a corporation or partnership meets the gross receipts test of § 448(c) for any taxable year if the average annual gross receipts of such entity for the 3-taxable-year period ending with the taxable year which precedes such taxable year does not exceed $31,000,000.
